name: boss
description: Expert-squad workflow for Codex: role agents from PM to DevOps, each held to a contract that an independent verifier checks.

interface.shortDescription: Auditable multi-agent engineering workflow for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Boss turns Codex into a structured engineering team. Each role writes an artifact to .boss/<feature>/ and is held to a hard-requirement contract, checked by a script and an independent verifier. Run a single stage on an existing codebase or the full pipeline from requirements to shipping.
defaultPrompt: Use Boss to review the current branch.
Run Boss QA on this project.
Use Boss to build this feature end to end.
